whenToUse: Developer consoles with minimal chrome where navigation and actions live in a command palette.
Live request logs, API keys and webhooks pages.
avoidWhen: Users who are not keyboard-centric — use shell-01.
Only managing keys inside settings — use settings-04.
a11y: The live log announces through aria-live and dialogs are labelled; keep visible entry points for ⌘K so navigation is discoverable.
